description: This Java class 'HeaderTranslator' provides utility methods for translating and filtering headers between external sources and internal representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It manages header definitions, filters headers, and facilitates conversion between external headers and Ditto headers, supporting operations like retaining known headers and merging headers with special handling for certain keys.

classes.name: HeaderTranslator
classes.description: Utility class for translating headers between external and internal formats, applying filtering based on header definitions, and managing header definitions for protocol purposes.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator instance with no header definitions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a HeaderTranslator from provided arrays of header definitions, merging based on keys with special handling for 'timeout'.

methods.name: fromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts external header map to an internal headers map, filtering based on known definitions.

methods.name: toExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts internal DittoHeaders to external headers map, filtering out unknown headers.

methods.name: retainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Filters external headers to retain only those headers known to this translator.

methods.name: toExternalAndRetainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders to external headers and filters out unknown headers in a single operation.

methods.name: forgetHeaderKeys
methods.description: Returns a new HeaderTranslator instance with specified header keys removed from its knowledge.
